name: Kai to Yumeminu Majo
source:
“Wait… is this… isekai reincarnation?!”

I woke up in an unfamiliar cave.

As soon as I focused, a status screen appeared before my eyes, along with a list of skills. And then there was the ability I remembered—the power to retry as many times as I wanted, no matter how many times I failed.

“I did say I wanted a power that would let me never lose to anyone…”

But this wasn’t quite what I had in mind.

“Being able to retry infinitely after losing doesn’t mean I can’t lose… That’s not it! That’s not it at all!!”

No legendary sword, no explosive magic—nothing. Surviving in another world like this was beyond impossible for an ordinary person.

Can I really survive in this world?

translation:
“等等……这就是……异界转生吗？！”

我在一个陌生的山洞里醒来。

当我集中注意力的时候，我的眼前出现了一个状态屏幕，以及一个技能列表。然后是我记得的一种能力——无论我失败了多少次，都可以随心所欲地重试。

“我确实说过，我想要一种让我永远不会输给任何人的力量……”

但这并不完全是我的想法。

“输了之后可以无限次重试，并不代表我就不会输……不是这样的！根本不是这样的！！”

没有传奇之剑，没有爆炸性魔法——什么都没有。在这样的异世界生存，对于普通人来说根本就是不可能的事。

我真的能在这个世界上生存吗？
